body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung announced two exciting additions to its HD family of devices. The NV24 HD digital camera provides HD imagines with its 10 mega-pixel resolution and super wide angle zoom lens, while plugging in via an HDMI cable to the living room HDTV.

On the video product, Samsung released new flash-based 1080p HD camcorder ‘HMX20’ allowing consumers to show clear home videos on their Full HD flat screens TVs. With an included docking station, users will find it simple to not only charge the SC-HMX20C, but utilize the HDMI input and component connectivity to easily view home movies directly on an HDTV. Furthermore, users are able to connect the SC-HMX20C to their laptop or PC via a USB connection and share their home movies with family and friends quickly and easily.
